correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    n=len(g)//3; m=len(g[0])//3
    out=[]
    for i in range(n):
        row=[]
        for j in range(m):
            vals=[g[i*3+a][j*3+b] for a in range(3) for b in range(3)]
            cc={v:v.count(v) for v in set(vals)}
            top=max(cc.values())
            row.append(next(iter({v for v,c in cc.items() if c==top})) if top>1 else 0)
        out.append(row)
    return out
